REQUIRED a fix first: gabor.cpp stored the filter-response magnitudes as PixIntens (unsigned int), truncating sub-integer responses to 0; now kept real-valued (double CPU/nt, RealPixIntens GPU).

vetted vs OpenCV cv2.Laplacian(roi, CV_64F, ksize=1, BORDER_CONSTANT).var() = 34.9565972 (cv2 4.13.0, gen_imq_opencv.py) in test_imq_opencv.h (TEST_IMQ_FOCUS_SCORE_OPENCV). Nyxus' hand-rolled laplacian() is bit-identical to cv2's filtered image (max abs diff 0.0), so only the variance step needed agreeing. Two bugs fixed to get there: (1) laplacian() multiplied PixIntens (unsigned) by the negative kernel weights, wrapping to 2.81e18; (2) variance() took |x| before the variance, giving Var(|X|) instead of Var(X) -- 12.109 vs 34.957, 65% low, since zero padding keeps the Laplacian mean (-0.958 here) away from 0. SCOPE: ksize=1 only (the ksize>1 kernel has no cv2 counterpart and calculate() never selects it); out-of-core get_focus_score_NT not covered.

vetted vs OpenCV: the same cv2.Laplacian call on the extracted tile, /scale^2 = 7.5763889 (cv2 4.13.0, gen_imq_opencv.py) in test_imq_opencv.h (TEST_IMQ_LOCAL_FOCUS_SCORE_OPENCV). Same two fixes as FOCUS_SCORE; the pre-fix pinned 7.57639 was accidentally right because the top-left tile has no zero pixels, so the unsigned wrap shifted every Laplacian value by the same 2^32 and abs() became a no-op -- the overflow fix alone moved it to a wrong 2.68056. SCOPE: the top-left tile only. get_local_focus_score() loops y < height-M with M=height/scale, so with scale=2 exactly ONE tile is visited, not scale^2=4; the assertion pins that tiling, it does not endorse it (the `<`-vs-`<=` bound and the docs' 'mean and median of the tiles' are untouched).

NOT vetted: value is 0.0 because rps() early-returns when min(h,w)/8 < 3 (fixture too small), AND power_spectrum.cpp:169 bins the radial power by the FFT VALUE as the radius index instead of the frequency radius sqrt(kx^2+ky^2) -- a real bug. Needs a radial-binning rewrite + a >=24 px fixture, then vet vs CellProfiler MeasureImageQuality (centrosome.radial_power_spectrum.rps), which is the implementation this was ported from.

vetted vs CellProfiler 4.2.8 MeasureImageQuality Image_ImageQuality_PercentMaximal/100 = 0.16666666666666669 = 16/96 (gen_imq_cellprofiler.py) in test_imq_cellprofiler.h (TEST_IMQ_MAX_SATURATION_CELLPROFILER).
